description.p: Kalamus is a Markdown editor for KDE Plasma that formats your text as you write. Headings grow, bold turns bold, tables become grids, formulas and images show in place, and the Markdown syntax hides away except on the line you are editing. The file on disk always stays plain Markdown.

ul.li: Live preview in the editor itself, with no separate preview pane
Tables you can edit as grids, LaTeX math, images, and code in color
Spell checking, an outline of headings, and find and replace
Export to HTML and PDF, or to Word and ODT with pandoc
Built with Qt 6 and KDE Frameworks 6, following your Plasma colors and fonts
